content.json:
## Agent inventory and privileges

Reads the Entra sign-in, audit and Microsoft Graph activity logs in this workspace and shows which agents exist, what they can do and what changed on them. It does not change anything.

**How agents are identified.** The `Agent` column of `AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs` (`agentType` of `agenticAppInstance` or `agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal`), over the last 90 days. An agent that has not signed in during that period is not listed. Type the object ids (service principal id, app id or blueprint app id) of agents that never signed in, or of agents that are ordinary service principals, in **Extra ids** and every tab includes them. `AgentsInfo` is not used because it has no rows in a workspace without the Defender XDR connector.

**Requires** the diagnostic settings `AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs`, `AuditLogs` and, for the Privileges tab, `MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs` exported to the workspace.

parameters.name: ExtraIds
parameters.label: Extra ids (comma separated)
parameters.description: Service principal ids, app ids or blueprint app ids of agents that do not appear in the sign-in logs. Leave the default if you have none.

content.json: Which agent identities and blueprint principals exist, how active they are, and which blueprint created which identity. A blueprint principal is not an agent: it holds the credentials and creates agent identities, so it is listed separately by type.

content.query:
let extra = set_difference(split(tolower(replace_string('{ExtraIds}', ' ', '')), ','), dynamic(["", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]));
let agent_signins = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | extend A = parse_json(Agent)
    | extend AgentType = tostring(A.agentType), BlueprintAppId = tostring(A.parentAppId)
    | where AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal") or tolower(ServicePrincipalId) in (extra)
    | extend AgentType = iff(AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal"), AgentType, "listed in ExtraIds");
agent_signins
| where TimeGenerated > ago({Days}d)
| summarize Agents = dcount(ServicePrincipalId) by AgentType
| order by Agents desc
content.title: Agents by type (signed in during the selected range)
content.noDataMessage: No agent sign-in in the selected range.

content.query:
let extra = set_difference(split(tolower(replace_string('{ExtraIds}', ' ', '')), ','), dynamic(["", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]));
let agent_signins = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | extend A = parse_json(Agent)
    | extend AgentType = tostring(A.agentType), BlueprintAppId = tostring(A.parentAppId)
    | where AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal") or tolower(ServicePrincipalId) in (extra)
    | extend AgentType = iff(AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal"), AgentType, "listed in ExtraIds");
let agent_types = agent_signins
    | extend K = pack_array(ServicePrincipalId, AppId)
    | mv-expand K
    | extend K = tolower(tostring(K))
    | where isnotempty(K)
    | summarize InitiatorType = take_any(AgentType) by K;
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({Days}d)
| where OperationName in ("Add application", "Add service principal")
| extend K = tolower(coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.app.servicePrincipalId), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.appId)))
| join kind=inner agent_types on K
| where InitiatorType == "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal"
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Result, Initiator = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
    NewObject = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName), NewObjectId = tostring(TargetResources[0].id), NewObjectType = tostring(TargetResources[0].type)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Objects created by an agent blueprint (the documented way agent identities are created)
content.noDataMessage: No object was created by an agent blueprint principal in the selected range.

content.json: What the agents can do, from three sources: the roles and scopes carried by their Microsoft Graph tokens, the role, app role and consent changes recorded in `AuditLogs`, and who changed credentials, owners and sponsors on agent objects. Inherited permissions are not shown on agent identities in the Entra admin center or Microsoft Graph, only in the token claims at runtime, so the first table is the one that shows them.

content.query:
let extra = set_difference(split(tolower(replace_string('{ExtraIds}', ' ', '')), ','), dynamic(["", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]));
let agent_signins = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | extend A = parse_json(Agent)
    | extend AgentType = tostring(A.agentType), BlueprintAppId = tostring(A.parentAppId)
    | where AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal") or tolower(ServicePrincipalId) in (extra)
    | extend AgentType = iff(AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal"), AgentType, "listed in ExtraIds");
let agent_keys = set_union(
    coalesce(toscalar(agent_signins | extend K = pack_array(ServicePrincipalId, AppId, BlueprintAppId) | mv-expand K | extend K = tolower(tostring(K)) | where isnotempty(K) | summarize make_set(K)), dynamic([])),
    extra);
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({Days}d)
| where tolower(ServicePrincipalId) in (agent_keys) or tolower(AppId) in (agent_keys)
| extend Path = replace_string(tostring(split(RequestUri, "?")[0]), "https://graph.microsoft.com/", "/")
| summarize Calls = count(), Failed = countif(ResponseStatusCode >= 400), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
    Methods = make_set(RequestMethod, 5), Paths = make_set(Path, 5) by AppId, ServicePrincipalId, Roles, Scopes
| order by Calls desc
content.title: Roles and scopes the agent tokens carried on Microsoft Graph
content.noDataMessage: No Microsoft Graph call from an agent in the selected range (the MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs diagnostic setting must be on).

content.query:
let extra = set_difference(split(tolower(replace_string('{ExtraIds}', ' ', '')), ','), dynamic(["", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]));
let agent_signins = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | extend A = parse_json(Agent)
    | extend AgentType = tostring(A.agentType), BlueprintAppId = tostring(A.parentAppId)
    | where AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal") or tolower(ServicePrincipalId) in (extra)
    | extend AgentType = iff(AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal"), AgentType, "listed in ExtraIds");
let agent_keys = set_union(
    coalesce(toscalar(agent_signins | extend K = pack_array(ServicePrincipalId, AppId, BlueprintAppId) | mv-expand K | extend K = tolower(tostring(K)) | where isnotempty(K) | summarize make_set(K)), dynamic([])),
    extra);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({Days}d)
| where OperationName in ("Add app role assignment to service principal", "Add app role assignment grant to user", "Add delegated permission grant",
    "Consent to application", "Add member to role", "Add eligible member to role", "Create role assignment")
| where tolower(tostring(TargetResources)) has_any (agent_keys) or tolower(tostring(InitiatedBy)) has_any (agent_keys)
| mv-expand TR = TargetResources
| mv-expand MP = TR.modifiedProperties
| extend Prop = tostring(MP.displayName), Value = trim(@'[\[\]" ]+', tostring(MP.newValue))
| where Prop in ("AppRole.Value", "DelegatedPermissionGrant.Scope", "Role.DisplayName", "ConsentContext.IsAdminConsent")
| extend Detail = case(Prop == "ConsentContext.IsAdminConsent", strcat("admin consent: ", Value), isempty(Value), "(no role value)", Value)
| extend Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)),
    ActorType = iff(isnotempty(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)), "user", "application")
| summarize Detail = make_set(Detail), Targets = make_set(coalesce(tostring(TR.displayName), tostring(TR.userPrincipalName)))
    by TimeGenerated, OperationName, Result, CorrelationId, Actor, ActorType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Role assignments, app roles and consents involving agent objects
content.noDataMessage: No role, app role or consent change involving an agent object in the selected range.

let agent_signins = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | extend A = parse_json(Agent)
    | extend AgentType = tostring(A.agentType), BlueprintAppId = tostring(A.parentAppId)
    | where AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal") or tolower(ServicePrincipalId) in (extra)
    | extend AgentType = iff(AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal"), AgentType, "listed in ExtraIds");

    extra);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({Days}d)
| where OperationName in ("Add service principal credentials", "Add owner to application", "Add owner to service principal", "Add user sponsor")
    or OperationName contains "Certificates and secrets management"
| where tolower(tostring(TargetResources)) has_any (agent_keys)
| mv-apply TR = TargetResources on (
    summarize Objects = make_set(strcat(tostring(TR.type), ": ", coalesce(tostring(TR.displayName), tostring(TR.userPrincipalName), tostring(TR.id)))))
| extend Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName)),
    ActorType = iff(isnotempty(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)), "user", "application")
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Result, Objects, Actor, ActorType
| order by TimeGenerated desc

content.noDataMessage: No credential, owner or sponsor change on an agent object in the selected range.

content.json: How the agents sign in: new IP addresses, more than one country, and which sign-ins Conditional Access evaluated. For agent identities the only Conditional Access control is Block. Sign-ins at the `AAD Token Exchange Endpoint: Public` and the token a blueprint requests to create identities are outside Conditional Access and show as `notApplied`, so judge the policy on sign-ins to a real resource such as Microsoft Graph. The policy design is in the `secure-ca-policy-agents` skill.

content.query:
let extra = set_difference(split(tolower(replace_string('{ExtraIds}', ' ', '')), ','), dynamic(["", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]));
let agent_signins = AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
    | extend A = parse_json(Agent)
    | extend AgentType = tostring(A.agentType), BlueprintAppId = tostring(A.parentAppId)
    | where AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal") or tolower(ServicePrincipalId) in (extra)
    | extend AgentType = iff(AgentType in ("agenticAppInstance", "agentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal"), AgentType, "listed in ExtraIds");
let signins = agent_signins | where ResultType == "0";
signins
| summarize FirstSeenIP = min(TimeGenerated), SignIns = count() by ServicePrincipalName, ServicePrincipalId, AgentType, IPAddress, Location
| join kind=leftouter (signins | summarize FirstSeenAgent = min(TimeGenerated) by ServicePrincipalId) on ServicePrincipalId
| where FirstSeenIP > ago({Days}d)
| extend Baseline = iff(FirstSeenAgent < ago({Days}d), "New IP for an agent with earlier sign-ins", "Agent has no earlier history")
| project FirstSeenIP, ServicePrincipalName, ServicePrincipalId, AgentType, IPAddress, Location, SignIns, Baseline
| order by FirstSeenIP desc
content.title: IP addresses an agent used for the first time in the selected range
content.noDataMessage: No agent used a new IP address in the selected range.
